opening.argument: This is a property marketing presentation with identifiable offerings and a contact route. The speaker describes available residential plots, gives a plot cost and booking percentage, and invites interested investors to call; the presentation also identifies commercial plots. Its statements about a substantial return and a future price increase are promotional claims about the property, not representations that approval has already been obtained. The speaker expressly says approval is not yet available and has been requested, then makes the predicted price increase conditional on receiving it. Read together, those details present an ordinary property offering while disclosing the limitation on the approval claim.
